rows.corpus_definition: To pull back or leave a place or situation.
rows.example_en: The army decided to withdraw from the city.

rows.corpus_definition: To refuse to give something that is asked for.
rows.example_en: The company decided to withhold information from the public.

rows.corpus_definition: An area of land that has many trees growing on it.
rows.example_en: We walked through the quiet wooded hills all morning.

rows.corpus_definition: To give up control or produce a result like food.
rows.example_en: Farmers expect their crops to yield plenty of corn.

rows.corpus_definition: The study of animals and their life.
rows.example_en: She decided to study zoology at the university.
